title: Phase1 example tests heap-own step-sequencer processors and link a Windows-sized stack on Apple

needles: ## A step-sequencer processor is too big for more than one per test stack

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes. The edits are confined to example test translation units and the test-only target's link options, none of which ship in an SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The tests drive TimelineStepSequencerProcessor directly.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing under tools/mcp reads or registers these tests.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. The processor is unchanged; only where the tests allocate it moved from the stack to the heap.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Changing test-local storage publishes no design-time capability.
